name: Korzo and the Centre
tagline: The main promenade between the port and the city tower
description: Rijeka's central pedestrian street runs parallel to the harbour under Austro-Hungarian facades, with the city tower, the market halls and the cafes along it. The bars in the streets behind carry the city's nightlife, and the port and station are both a few minutes away.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the market, the bars and the ferries within a short walk
pros: The fish and produce market halls nearby
Bars and restaurants throughout the back streets
Port, station and bus terminal all close
cons: The highest rents in the city

name: Trsat
tagline: Up the stairs to the castle, with the whole bay below
description: The hill above the city, reached by a long flight of baroque pilgrimage steps or by bus, holding the castle, the pilgrimage church and the university campus. The view over the Kvarner gulf is the best in Rijeka, and the district is quieter and greener than anything below.
bestFor: Stays that want the castle, the view and the university campus
pros: The best views over the gulf and the islands
Castle grounds and the university nearby
Quieter and cooler than the centre
cons: The stairs are a serious daily commitment

name: Bulevard and Belveder
tagline: The Austro-Hungarian villa slopes above the centre
description: The hillside immediately behind the Korzo, laid out in the late nineteenth century with stepped streets and substantial villas built when Rijeka was Hungary's port. It is a short but steep walk from the centre, quieter, and the housing stock is the most characterful in the city.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting period apartments and a view, with stairs accepted
pros: Handsome period buildings and sea views
Five to ten minutes above the Korzo

name: Zamet and the Western Districts
tagline: Residential blocks west of the centre, best everyday value
description: The residential belt running west along the coast, with post-war and newer apartment blocks, supermarkets, schools and a sports hall, plus bus links along the coastal road. Rents here are the lowest in Rijeka and some blocks look straight out over the gulf.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a normal flat with a sea view at a low rent
pros: The lowest rents in the city, some with sea views
cons: Fifteen to twenty minutes into the centre

name: Opatija (15 km west)
tagline: The Habsburg riviera resort along the coast
description: The nineteenth century spa resort fifteen kilometres west, built when Vienna's aristocracy wintered here, with grand hotels, a seaside promenade running for twelve kilometres and Ucka rising directly behind. It is prettier and considerably more expensive than Rijeka, with frequent buses between them.
bestFor: Stays that want the resort promenade and the mountain, with the city close
pros: The Lungomare coastal promenade and the parks
Frequent buses into Rijeka in twenty-five minutes
cons: Crowded in summer, quiet in winter
